CG minimal-polynomial degree establishes universal two-step termination iff a two-value spectrum exists; the condition penalty diverges as v approaches b-c from below. value.rationale: The flat-bulk model isolates the precise issue in spectral recycling: a reused reference eigenvector ceases to diagonalize the perturbed matrix. The result shows exactly when optimal condition-number tuning is also an exact two-iteration preconditioner, when these two objectives separate, and when the two-iteration goal becomes impossible. The forced-condition penalty can be unbounded while the minimax condition number stays bounded; this provides a nonasymptotic benchmark for finite-budget spectral preconditioner choice, beyond generic eigenvalue tuning or a small numerical constant.
